migration-accelerator/capabilities/platforms/hubspot.yaml — consent.model, object_catalog.consent_and_identity.subscription_types and preference_pages. The base wording's bottom option, "standard publication or subscription lists", is a Marketing Cloud construct and on THIS target it is not even the target's own construct: MCN's consent model is a Spring '26+ capability whose parity is unverified, which is why slot 7 here carries a ceiling. That ceiling belongs on the readiness axis and is not repeated here — how many permission categories the client has is a fact about the client, and it does not become a smaller number because the destination is unfinished. COUNTS AND PLACES ONLY.
